findings.location: Throughout the article where Bible verses are quoted (e.g. Matthew 16:25; John 14:15; 1 John 2:4; John 13:35; James 5:5-6; Luke 8:14; 2 Timothy 3:1-5; Revelation 3:15-16; Ephesians 4:11-13).
findings.source_quote:
For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it –Matthew 16:25.

If ye love me, keep my commandments –John 14:15. And, He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him –1 John 2:4.

By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another –John 13:35.

Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter. Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you –James 5:5-6.

And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection –Luke 8:14.

This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come. For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy, Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good, Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God; Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away –2 Timothy 3:1-5.

I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot. So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth –Revelation 3:15-16.

And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ: – Ephesians 4:11-13.

With: 무릇 자기 목숨을 구하는 자는 잃을 것이요 나를 위하여 자기 목숨을 잃는 자는 얻으리라 –마태복음 16:25. - Replace: If ye love me, keep my commandments –John 14:15. And, He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him –1 John 2:4. With: 너희가 나를 사랑하면 내 계명을 지키리라 –요한복음 14:15. 또 누구든지 내가 그를 안다고 하고 그 계명을 지키지 아니하면 그는 거짓말하는 자요 진리가 그 안에 있지 아니하니라 –요한일서 2:4. - Apply the same approach to all other quoted verses (John 13:35; James 5:5-6; Luke 8:14; 2 Timothy 3:1-5; Revelation 3:15-16; Ephesians 4:11-13), using conventional Korean Bible wording and keeping the verse citations unchanged. Ensure the translated verses are placed inside the same … tags as in the source HTML.
